name: Lunar Nodes Specification
description: Foundational definition of lunar nodes (North Node and South Node) with karmic and spiritual significance

lunar_nodes_overview.definition: Lunar nodes are the points where the Moon's orbit intersects the ecliptic (Earth's orbital plane)
lunar_nodes_overview.meaning: Represent karmic soul lessons and evolutionary development
lunar_nodes_overview.cycle: Approximately 18.6 years per complete nodal cycle

north_node.name: North Node
north_node.meaning: Soul's evolutionary direction, future growth, gifts to develop, life purpose

house_meanings.meaning: Develop authentic self-expression and independence
Develop healthy values, stability, and self-worth
Develop communication skills, curiosity, and learning
Develop emotional roots, family connection, and security
Develop creativity, confidence, and joy
Develop service, organization, and health practices
Develop partnership skills, balance, and diplomacy
Develop depth, intimacy, transformation abilities
Develop faith, wisdom, and spiritual understanding
Develop authority, career purpose, and public contribution
Develop community connection, ideals, and group participation
Develop spirituality, compassion, and inner wisdom

south_node.name: South Node
south_node.meaning: Past life talents, inherited gifts, comfort zone, karmic patterns to transcend

house_meanings.meaning: Past self-reliance; growth toward partnership
Past material focus; growth toward non-material values
Past scattered learning; growth toward focused wisdom
Past family dependence; growth toward independent foundation
Past creative indulgence; growth toward purposeful expression
Past perfectionism; growth toward compassion in service
Past co-dependency; growth toward balanced autonomy
Past avoidance of depth; growth toward transformation
Past blind faith; growth toward discernment
Past career focus; growth toward personal meaning
Past group conformity; growth toward authentic ideals
Past spiritual escapism; growth toward grounded spirituality

node_axis_interpretation.description: The North and South nodes form an axis; understanding both points reveals complete karmic picture
node_axis_interpretation.principle: South Node comfort must be released to develop North Node growth

nodal_signs_interpretation.karmic_lesson: Release material security; develop emotional depth/transformation
Release ego focus; develop group consciousness/idealism
Release rigid control; develop emotional authenticity/nurturing
